title: Saint Seiya New Generation Cosmetic
description: This is a small mod about Saint Seiya cosmetic
body:
This is a small mod that I created to add outfits, masks, and other cosmetics from the Saint Seiya universe.

Some updates will come at a later date.

**Dependencies** : CuriosAPI

Feel free to join the Discord server to suggest your outfit ideas.
They could potentially be added. Here is the link
https://discord.gg/JNqrnxdjVE

This is just a cosmetic mod that you can use in addition to the main mod, “Saint Seiya New Generation.”
